scenes.line1: How does SQL run your query?
scenes.say: Ever wonder what happens when you run a SQL query? Why should you care about the execution plan?

scenes.label: EXPLAIN
scenes.sub: Shows how the database processes your query
scenes.say: EXPLAIN shows you exactly how the database processes your query, step by step.

scenes.title: EXPLAIN Example
scenes.say: Here's how you use EXPLAIN. It reveals if your query uses an index or scans the whole table.
Execution plans show index usage, join methods, and scan types. All impact performance.

scenes.question: What causes slow queries?
scenes.right: Full table scans and missing indexes are common bottlenecks.
scenes.say: Interviewers may ask what causes slow queries. It's not just bad syntax—full table scans and missing indexes are big culprits.
